section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces Study 2, which aimed to replicate the null effect of insight on achievement found in Study 1 and to further explore the role of insight in everyday creative behavior. Study 2 also investigated the role of fluid intelligence (Gf) in creative behavior and achievement, expecting Gf to predict achievement based on prior research. The study sought to determine if real-world creativity is linked to controlled (Gf) or unconscious (insight) thought processes.
